content_sections.heading: Chengalpattu District Health Society Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: This is a recruitment of Staff Nurses for Comprehensive Emergency Obstetric and Newborn Care (CEMONC) centres, including SNCU and PICU, in Chengalpattu District. The posts are contractual and temporary.

content_sections.heading: About Chengalpattu District Health Society
content_sections.text: The District Health Society, Chengalpattu is the district health society of the Public Health and Preventive Medicine Department, through which the National Health Mission, Tamil Nadu is implemented in Chengalpattu District. The notice is signed by the Member Secretary / District Health Officer and the Chairman / District Collector of the society.

content_sections.heading: Chengalpattu District Health Society Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: As of 20 November 2026, applications have not yet opened; they begin tomorrow.

content_sections.heading: Chengalpattu District Health Society Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The notice prints 57 vacancies for a single post. No category-wise break-up is given.

content_sections.heading: Chengalpattu District Health Society Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details of the post.

rows.qualification_required: GNM/B.Sc. Nursing from a Government or Government-approved Private Nursing College, recognised by the Indian Nursing Council. Valid registration with the Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council.

content_sections.heading: Chengalpattu District Health Society Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The age limit for the Staff Nurse post is up to 50 years. The notice prints no cut-off date for counting age and lists no age relaxation.

content_sections.heading: Job Details and Terms
content_sections.text: The Staff Nurses will be engaged on contract under the National Health Mission, Tamil Nadu, in the CEMONC centres of Chengalpattu District, including SNCU and PICU. The notice states these conditions: The post is purely on a contract/temporary basis. The post will not be made permanent at any time. Candidates must submit an undertaking letter agreeing to the conditions of joining.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Chengalpattu District Health Society Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the website https://chengalpattu.nic.in . Fill in the application form. Enclose self-attested copies of all certificates supporting the details in the application. Send the application in person or by Speed Post to the Member Secretary / District Health Officer, District Health Society, Chengalpattu District - 603001. Make sure the application reaches the office by 5.45 PM on 4 December 2026. Applications received after 5.45 PM on 04 December 2026 will not be accepted. The office telephone number printed in the notice is 044-29540261.

content_sections.heading: Documents Named in the Notice
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of all certificates supporting the application Undertaking letter agreeing to the conditions of joining
